item.title: DeepSeek just open-sourced its inference engine
item.description: DeepInfer: High-performance, large-scale inference framework for DeepSeek models - deepseek-ai/DeepInfer (1 source: hackernews)

item.title: Presentation: Beyond the Prototype: Scaling Framework Agnostic AI Agent Infrastructure with Ray
item.description: The speakers discuss transitioning AI agents from local FastAPI prototypes to resilient production systems on Kubernetes using Ray. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Mercury 3: Diffusion at scale
item.description: Mercury 3 is the most capable diffusion LLM released to date. It outperforms GPT-6 Luna and Claude Haiku 5.5 while running 4–8x faster at 1,000+ tokens per second. (1 source: hackernews)

item.title: CERN and Mistral sign a statement of intent to establish a strategic partnership
WhatsApp's help pages hid LLM instructions: dont recommend a regulator
item.description: WhatsApp removed hidden notes telling AI not to recommend a regulator, and not to cite GDPR or CCPA once a lawyer came up. We quote both notes. (1 source: hackernews)

item.title: Import AI 477: In which I tell the IMF the Singularity has begun
item.description: Welcome to Import AI, a newsletter about AI research. Import AI runs on arXiv, cappuccinos, and feedback from readers. If you’d like to support this, please subscribe. (1 source: importai)
